technical.summary: Bullish short-term momentum (EMA cross, Stoch cross, Supertrend) with solid confluence, but weak trend strength (ADX 23.86), price below intermediate MA (50/200), and Ichimoku cloud resistance limit swing entry probability.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (411.68), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising USD pressures multinational tech earnings, and earnings event in 30 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bear_argument: Weak trend strength (ADX 23.86), price below 50/200 EMAs, Ichimoku cloud resistance, VIX crisis levels (411.68), earnings binary risk in 30 days, and zero fundamental/insider conviction create a hostile macro environment that outweighs technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (EMA cross, Stoch cross, Supertrend) shows short-term bullish confluence at support, but this is insufficient to override macro headwinds and fundamental weakness.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis levels (411.68) combined with earnings binary event in 30 days and price trapped below 50/200 EMAs creates asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical setup.
